title: Oh My God Bro, Oh Hell Nah
blurb: Two stages, and the second is the important one. Stage one registers disbelief; stage two withdraws from the situation entirely. That escalation structure is what makes the clip so useful, because it gives an edit somewhere to go — the reaction develops rather than simply happening. The weariness in the delivery is what sells it: this is somebody who has seen a number of things and has decided that this one exceeds the limit. When a single nah will not cover it, here is the certified escalation package.
origin: A viral two-part disbelief reaction clip.
